## New in 1.1.0: Android Auto

AisleTunes now shows up in Android Auto with its own icon. Tap **Walmart & Sam's Club Radio** on the car screen to tune in. The dash shows the song, artist and cover art, and play/stop work from the screen and the steering wheel.

**One-time setup for Android Auto:** Android Auto hides apps that weren't installed from the Play Store. On your phone, open Android Auto's settings, tap **Version** about ten times to unlock developer settings, then open the ⋮ menu → **Developer settings** and turn on **Unknown sources**. Restart Android Auto and AisleTunes will appear.

Also new: pressing play on Bluetooth headphones or the car starts the station even when the app isn't open.

## Install

Download the `.apk` below on your Android phone (Android 8.0 or newer) and open it. It installs over 1.0.0.

## Everything AisleTunes does

- Live stream of Walmart & Sam's Club Radio
- Now playing: song, artist, album, year and cover art
- Recently played list
- Keeps playing in the background, with lock-screen and Bluetooth controls
- Android Auto support
- Rejoins the live broadcast after a long pause
